description: Every structure satisfying a finite ground literal problem excludes both equality conflicts and opposite-sign relation conflicts.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.conflict_sound.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Relations n)]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Problem L) (M : Type w) [L.Structure M]
  (hM : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Satisfies Γ M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.ConflictFree Γ
